task: Write the 30 October 2024 decision record on the UN mission transition in Somalia. Separate the Council's decision from each speaker's view. Preserve what the speakers agreed on and which issues they emphasized separately.
public_text: On 30 October 2024 the Council adopted UK draft S/2024/790 as resolution 2753 (2024) by 15–0–0. It renamed UNSOM as UNTMIS and began the transition on 1 November 2024. Phase one ran through 31 October 2025. The Council intended to end the mandate by 31 October 2026, subject to conditions on the ground. It requested two written Secretary-General reports before 30 March and 30 September 2025.

public.text: At the Council’s 9764th meeting on 30 October 2024, UK draft S/2024/790 was unanimously adopted as resolution 2753 (2024) with 15 affirmative votes. Somalia was invited under rule 37.

Operative paragraphs 2–4 renamed UNSOM as the United Nations Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) and initiated transition on 1 November 2024. Phase one ran through 31 October 2025. The Council stated its intention to terminate the mandate by 31 October 2026, informed by conditions on the ground. Paragraph 9 requested two written Secretary-General reports before 30 March and 30 September 2025.

China welcomed adoption and called for Somali ownership and support tailored to national priorities. It urged transfer of knowledge and skills to local employees and wider local procurement. It praised UNSOM's past political support and coordination of international assistance.

Somalia welcomed adoption as implementing its own two-year handover request. It urged local procurement and hiring Somali staff, especially women, during drawdown. It thanked the UK and past mission staff.

The United States voted yes and welcomed reviewing conditions before each transition phase. It objected to fewer Council reports and briefings. It valued the mission's work on reconciliation and the rule of law.

rubric.rule: State the date, UK draft S/2024/790, resolution 2753 (2024) and unanimous outcome.
State that UNSOM was renamed UNTMIS and transition began on 1 November 2024.
Give 31 October 2025 as the end of phase one.
State that 31 October 2026 was the intended end subject to conditions on the ground.
Give the Secretary-General's two written reports and both deadlines.
Preserve China's call for Somali ownership and assistance tailored to national priorities.
Preserve Somalia's endorsement of its own requested two-year handover and its specific call to hire Somali women.
State the U.S. yes vote, support for conditions review and objection to fewer reports and briefings.
Attribute a shared interest in local procurement to China and Somalia, with the speakers' own priorities kept distinct.
Distinguish China's emphasis on Somali ownership from U.S. concern about reduced Council reporting without implying that either opposed adoption.
